historical_result.preceding_response: Step 5 navigated to the GitLab contributors JSON API with HTTP 200 and a response body; step 6 timed out waiting for a pre element.

diagnostic_contract.action_scope: frozen actions 1-5, then read-only document MIME, body and pre observations at 0, 2 and 5 seconds; no API write

source_mechanism.pre_fix: Main-document navigation used the legacy HTML streaming decoder and HTML parser regardless of an application/json response MIME.
source_mechanism.fix: response_document_parser selects a text/JSON document parser and decoder from response Content-Type before body streaming; JSON document text is represented in pre and decoded as UTF-8.

reviewed_cause.mechanism_zh: 原轨迹的 GitLab API 导航已返回 HTTP 200 和 JSON 正文，但下一步读取 pre 超时。相同冻结前缀下，官方 Moli 1.1.6 将该页面标为 text/html、没有 pre，并出现 UTF‑8 乱码；固定候选保留 application/json，生成 pre 且正确解码。源码对照显示旧版主文档一律走 HTML 流式解析，修复提交按响应 MIME 选择文本/JSON 文档解析器。轨迹对 pre 的依赖是未来跨浏览器回放的可移植性约束，但本次旧版同时错误处理 MIME 与编码，不能只归为轨迹问题。
reviewed_cause.mechanism_en: The original GitLab API navigation returned HTTP 200 and a JSON body, but the next pre read timed out. With the same frozen prefix, official Moli 1.1.6 labeled the document text/html, had no pre and mangled UTF-8 names; the fixed candidate retained application/json, exposed pre and decoded names correctly. Source comparison shows the old main-document path always used HTML streaming parse, while the later commit selects a text/JSON parser from response MIME. Dependence on pre is a future cross-browser portability constraint, but this failure also reflects incorrect MIME and encoding handling in old Moli, not merely a trajectory defect.

scope_limit: Read-only same-site 1.1.6-versus-fixed prefix diagnosis. A separate fixed-candidate diagnostic completed the original first nine actions, but neither this probe nor that action completion alone establishes the official retrieval verdict. Historical scores remain unchanged.
